research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ginkgo Bioworks is advancing in biological engineering with a focus on engineered cells for producing malonate and gadusol, as well as biosynthesis of mogrosides and cannabinoids. They are also developing immune cell stimulatory sequences and chimeric antigen receptors, enhancing the production of proteins and lipids in host cells. Their research spans across various applications, including gene therapy for diseases like Angelman syndrome and arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, and the use of AAV vectors targeting specific cells. These efforts highlight Ginkgo Bioworks' diverse R&D in custom microbes and biological products.

overview_description.description: Ginkgo Bioworks is a biotechnology firm. It is a developer of biological engineering products and custom microbes across multiple markets. It designs, engineer, develops, tests, and licenses organisms. It discovers molecules in flavors, sweeteners, cosmetic ingredients, crop treatments, and pharmaceuticals. It also provides probiotic bacteria to protect the body from dangerous infections, and it generates libraries of molecules. It serves cultured ingredients, carbon mitigation, probiotics, and natural product discovery markets.

legal_proceedings.description: Ginkgo Bioworks announced a proposed settlement of shareholder derivative actions in federal court (N.D. Cal.) and a related Delaware Chancery action, under which insurers for individual defendants will pay $4,125,000 to Ginkgo upon court approval. about_short_description.short_description: Ginkgo Bioworks is a developer of biological engineering products and custom microbes across multiple markets.

product.name: Ginkgo Reconfigurable Automation Cart (RAC) System
product.description: A modular laboratory automation platform that integrates robotic carts, instruments, and software to execute flexible, high-throughput biological workflows.

product.name: Ginkgo Automation Platform
product.description: An integrated hardware, web-based software, and support platform for designing, running, monitoring, and expanding automated biological laboratory workflows.

product.name: Catalyst Agent
product.description: An AI agent that converts scientific instructions into laboratory execution, manages automated protocols, monitors experiments, and provides conversational data analysis.

product.name: Ginkgo Datapoints
product.description: A data and AI/ML services offering that generates biological datasets and analytical outputs for research programs, including biologics, ADME, functional genomics, and specialized screening.

product.name: Ginkgo Solutions
product.description: A scientific R&D service that helps organizations define research goals, design experiments, and execute biological engineering and screening programs using Ginkgo’s infrastructure and expertise.

product.name: Ginkgo Cloud Lab
product.description: A virtual-access service that lets research teams order and run experiments on Ginkgo’s autonomous laboratory infrastructure in Boston.
